name: rest-hang-risks

result.rationale: Plugin-owned `mvs-pro/v1` REST endpoints — server response is bounded (DB-only, no upstream HTTP). Worst-case is a slow query, not an indefinite hang. Documented as known-debt for 1.2.1 hardening; not a 1.2.0 ship-blocker.

result.context: Admin connector import modal (browse remote / import / sync-delta)
result.rationale: These DO call upstream APIs (Flickr, etc.) on the server side via wp_remote_*. Without an AbortController on the JS side, the admin modal will spin until the WP request times out (default 5s for wp_remote_get). Not catastrophic but worth adding AbortController in 1.2.1.

result.context: Frontend Instagram-feed layout (infinite-scroll fetch + filter changes)
result.rationale: Plugin-owned REST endpoints; bounded. Could add AbortController to cancel inflight on rapid filter switches, but not a hang risk.

notes: Sub-check 2.5 — REST hang risk audit. Phase 3a/3b/3c/3d/3e blocks ADD ZERO new fetch/apiFetch calls — all 12 src/blocks/pro-* blocks delegate to server-side renderers (Tournaments\Renderer, Challenges\Renderer, Battles\Renderer, Frontend\LeaderboardRenderer, Frontend\CompeteHubRenderer) or to Frontend\Layouts\* classes. Editor-side preview uses src/blocks/shared/block-preview-card.js, a static React component with no fetch. ServerSideRender component is NOT used (deliberately replaced by BlockPreviewCard). The 10 files listed above are pre-existing assets/js/ store + admin scripts unchanged by 1.2.0 block work. Deferred remediation — adding AbortController to the 6 plugin-owned-REST stores is a clean 1.2.1 task; the 4 connector/admin scripts (medium severity) hit upstream APIs and should ship AbortController + a 10-second user-visible timeout in 1.2.1.
